name: Suzumura Saki
source:
The protagonist's step sister. She is neat, beautiful, and kind.

She has always loved the protagonist as a man, and has always held smoldering feelings for him in her heart.

As a result of her distorted love for him, she has decided to take this incident as an opportunity to take her brother in her arms and give him all the love he has been holding in his heart.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momofero/product/dadaama/index.html]official site[/url]]
